description: Golden vectors for erp/v2 posting catalogue version 2 (ADR-SHARED-034, ADR-SHARED-037). Each vector overlays operation_class, legal_actor_role and activity onto posting-authority-decision-authorized.json; VALID must validate as a PostingAuthorityDecision and INVALID must not. Role mismatches cover every organisation/v2 legalActorRole, not only roles the catalogue uses. Consumers (CP resolver, ERP PEP) use them to prove the class-to-role/activity binding. Synthetic contract fixtures only; never evidence of a mandate or posting support.
